## Tree

```text
├── docs/
├── frontend-build/
└── src/
    ├── main/
    │   ├── java/
    │   └── resources/
    └── test/
        └── java/
```

## What lives where

| Folder | What lives here |
|---|---|
| `docs/` | Project documentation and plans |
| `frontend-build/` | Production build: minifies and obfuscates the static front end (Node) |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/config/` | Rate limiter, caches, keep-alive scheduler |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/controller/` | Page routes (ViewHandler) and REST endpoints |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/exceptionhandler/` | Global error handling |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/model/` | Request and response models |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/sdlc/` | Claude Code SDLC generator (server-side, private) |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/service/` | Service interfaces |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/serviceImpl/` | Conversion and formatting logic |
| `src/main/java/com/payload/parser/utils/` | Shared helpers |
| `src/main/resources/sdlc-templates/` | SDLC kit templates (CLAUDE.md.tmpl and dot-claude/ are renamed when generated) |
| `src/main/resources/static/` | Front end: one HTML page per tool, served by ViewHandler routes |
| `src/main/resources/static/css/` | Stylesheets (tools.css is shared by tool pages) |
| `src/main/resources/static/js/` | Front-end scripts, one per tool |
| `src/test/java/` | JUnit 5 tests |
